messages:
sam: Heads up — nightly eval (promptset 14) regressed after the kernel-refactor merge (commit abc1234). Top-1 entropy dropped, more repeated tokens in stochastic sampling. cc @lee @anya :rotating_light:

ci-bot: nightly-evals/job/4532 completed. Failure delta vs baseline: +23%. Artifacts: https://ci.example.com/4532/output and summary: https://ci.example.com/4532/summary

lee: Reproduced locally with the new runtime image. Quick repro command:
```
# repro (local docker)
REPRO_SEED=42 docker run --rm -v $(pwd)/prompts:/prompts runtime:abc1234
  ./bin/runtime --model grove-7b.q4f --prompt-file /prompts/ps14.txt
  --sampler temperature=0.8,top_k=40 > out_abc1234.txt
```

lee: Observed repeated span around tokens with ids ~5023-5030. Example snippet from out_abc1234.txt:
```
... the quick brown fox jumps jumps jumps over the lazy dog ...
```

anya: I see the same pattern when running the quant q6f build. Sampler chooses the same highest-prob token repeatedly under the new fused path.

miguel: The refactor touched attention scratch layout + fused softmax selection in kernels. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/789 (files changed: fused_softmax.cu, attn_layout.h)

infra-bot: Canary rollback deployed to canary-2 cluster for runtime:abc1234 (rollback=false). Monitoring metrics: 5m token error/throughput unchanged.

sam: Triage plan: @lee run focused sampler + rng-distribution tests; @anya run softmax/scale unit tests and KL comparisons; @miguel bisect kernel change; infra will hold canaries if necessary.

lee: Quick code check — noticed a subtle change in softmax scaling in fused path. Pseudocode diff:
```
// old
logits /= sqrt(dk);
// new
logits *= rsqrt_bias; // rsqrt_bias computed from layout, might include scaling already
// result: possible double-scaling when combined with host-side scale
```

anya: I ran a 200-seed sampling KL test vs baseline. KL went from ~0.002 -> 0.12 on avg for promptset 14. Also see higher repeat-rate metric (repeat_rate_pct 4% -> 18%).

miguel: I'll run a git-bisect across PR 789 to find the exact commit that introduced the change in softmax derivation.

sam: Created GH issue #3421 to track (https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/3421). Assigning to @lee and @miguel. Add nightly eval target for promptset 14 with 100 seeds.

ci-bot: Rerun of nightly-eval job queued (job 4532-rerun). Expected completion ~30m.

lee: I can prepare a hotfix that restores previous explicit scaling (drop rsqrt_bias multiplication) and run unit tests. If tests pass I'll push patch tonight.

sam: :thumbsup: prioritize for patch release. Keep updates here.

infra-bot: Alerting: rolling canary rollback paused pending patch verification.

sam: Thanks all — please post minimal repro outputs and attach the small prompt index that triggers the worst drift. We want a deterministic CI test next.
